report.verdict: A strong data analyst resume for a nursing role that requires a different professional track.
write_up: This posting is for a registered nurse, while your resume tells the story of a data analyst in retail and insurance. I scored it for Data Analyst work: your reports connect technical work to decisions teams make, but they don't establish nursing qualifications.

The markdown line is a strong model. It names the analysis, the 2,100 SKUs, and the schedule the merchandising team adopted. Your current role also shows that you replaced a manual sales report with an automated one.

Your resume is strong for analyst roles and isn't likely to be the thing holding you back there. Let's make the ad hoc work more concrete and put the automated report closer to the top. For this nursing posting, the requirements call for a different set of qualifications.

cards.line: Pull ad hoc analyses for the VP of Sales, about 10 requests a month
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see how often the VP asks for analyses, but not what questions you answer. Naming one would show the kind of sales work you handle.
cards.example: Pull ad hoc analyses for the VP of Sales, about 10 requests a month, on [business questions]
cards.question: What sales questions do those analyses answer?

cards.line: Analyzed markdown timing for 2,100 SKUs; the merchandising team adopted the recommended schedule in two categories
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It takes the reader from a merchandising problem to a recommendation and shows what the team did with it.

cards.line: Build and maintain 14 Power BI dashboards used by the sales, merchandising, and finance teams
cards.cannot_tell: For a senior analyst role, a decision you made about reporting across teams would show more than dashboard maintenance alone.
cards.example: Build and maintain 14 Power BI dashboards used by the sales, merchandising, and finance teams; [a reporting decision you made] shaped [reporting approach]
cards.question: Did you make a reporting decision across these teams, and what did it shape?

cards.line: Wrote the SQL model that replaced a 3-day manual weekly sales report with an automated one
cards.cannot_tell: Move this above the dashboard line. The replacement of a 3-day manual report is your strongest opening for an analyst role.

fit.why: Your headline and current role focus on sales and operations analysis, SQL models, and Power BI dashboards.
fit.level: mid-level, Data Analyst role following a Junior Analyst role
fit.note: Your reporting and data work could be useful in a healthcare analytics setting. For this application, add any relevant qualifications you hold that aren't on your resume, but don't imply clinical experience you haven't had.

posting.summary: The role calls for licensed nursing practice on a medical-surgical night shift, including patient care and EHR documentation.
missing: Current unrestricted North Carolina RN license or compact state license
ACLS within six months of hire
Minimum 1 year of acute care nursing experience preferred; new graduates with a strong clinical rotation considered
Experience with Epic or a comparable EHR
Ability to manage a patient assignment of 5 to 6 patients
